supervision_labels.source_only: all Track C training uses SegPPD train_B only (772 images); PlantSeg is never used for training, selection or tuning here.
supervision_labels.target_supervised: NOT run in Track C (Track B M3/M4/M5 already is the PlantSeg-supervised setting, with its own official train/val/test partition).
supervision_labels.cross_source_mixed: NOT run (would need a cross-dataset duplicate-controlled mixed split; documented as future work).

status_of_evaluation_sets: Protocol B test, C test and the 1,485 strict external PlantSeg queries were all inspected before -> every Track C number on them is EXPLORATORY. The only selection set is the SegPPD dev set (150 queries).
C1_diagnosis: error rates of the existing D5ck models on the 1,485 external queries by crop, disease, resolution bin, source host, mask-ratio bin (PlantSeg 'Mask ratio' field), provisional organ labels (121-image random stratified sample annotated by ONE annotator - an AI - so NOT independently verified), top confusions, and in-domain performance on the same 11 classes; organ is never inferred from class names.

C2_augmentation.loss: Proxy-Anchor alpha=32 delta=0.3 (dev-selected in Track A)

variants.res: +random down/up-sampling (96-224 px), Gaussian blur, JPEG quality 40-95
variants.robust: all moderate families together (crop 0.5-1, rot 15, jitter .3/.3/.25/.03, down/up, blur, JPEG)

C2_augmentation.selection: SegPPD dev class-macro Hit@1, tie eps 1/150 then dev mAP (same rule as Track A) - external PlantSeg numbers are reported but never used to choose
C2_augmentation.seeds: variants seed 0; the dev-selected variant and 'robust' are repeated with seeds 1,2 for a 3-seed comparison against the existing 3-seed base
C2_augmentation.no_mask_background_swap: controlled background replacement was NOT used (SegPPD masks mark the annotated target region, not a reliable foreground/background split for whole-leaf classes)

C3_local_rerank.global_stage: exact squared L2 on the 256-D embedding, top-M
C3_local_rerank.local_stage: symmetric Chamfer similarity of L2-normalised last-layer patch tokens (16x16), no flip
C3_local_rerank.combination: alpha*cos_global + (1-alpha)*S_local over the top-M; M in {20,50}; alpha in {0,0.25,0.5,0.75}
C3_local_rerank.selection: SegPPD dev (Hit@1, tie eps then mAP), mean over 3 seeds
C3_local_rerank.inference_inputs: query image only: no class label, mask or image id
C3_local_rerank.measured: latency per query and patch-token memory

forbidden: No Track C decision uses an external PlantSeg or consumed-test number.
